datePolicy: Every primary source in the retained source index is explicitly accessed 2026-11-06. ECB rate date is 2026-11-05. Document effective dates are distinct. Authoring date is not source refresh, publication or current-law/medical certification.
uncertainties: No asthma-inclusive option is verified within £150/month; Native, Cigna and Allianz require underwriting and actual quotes.

SafetyWing Complete FAQ excludes pre-existing conditions while October 2026 wording allows disclosed conditions unless endorsed out; treat asthma as uninsured until issued terms resolve this. Conflicting US$161.50 calculator is not used.
Traveler and Essential exclude known chronic asthma; World Nomads UK pre-existing-condition exclusion cannot be bought out. Emergency benefits do not override condition exclusions.
Genki Native prior-prescribed-treatment and arrival-related exclusions need reconciliation with accepted asthma and existing inhaler prescriptions.
Allianz benefit table and guide carry different effective years; World Nomads legacy nib wording differs from current IMG distributor. Exact terms require matching offered documents.
No issued certificate, visa approval, personal quote or underwriting outcome exists. Portugal E11 whole stay, D9 initial 120 days and later health insurance OR SNS evidence remain separate tests.
London DTV1 checklist does not list insurance; this is not permanent exemption or plan approval. Six calendar months can exceed 180 days.
GHIC, NHS and SNS entitlement depend on actual residence and eligibility. Public healthcare does not establish private insurance or repatriation protection.
No external research, source changes, website changes, publication, applications or contact. No new medical/legal advice.
editingContract: English-only authoring: assigned Markdown, schema-v2 JSON and author-review note. Parent owns inventory, HTML build and full-package checks. No ratings, stars, Review or AggregateRating.
